Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Has Raised Its Magna Intl (MGA) Stake; As Achillion Pharmaceuticals (ACHN) Share Value Rose, Sarissa Capital Management LP Raised Stake
May 14, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc increased its stake in Magna Intl Inc (MGA) by 16.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc bought 22,290 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.65% with the market. The institutional investor held 156,000 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.84 million, up from 133,710 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Magna Intl Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.88B market cap company. The stock increased 3.20% or $2.02 during the last trading session, reaching $65.24. About 689,386 shares traded. Magna International Inc. (NYSE:MGA) has risen 26.62% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.07% the S&P500.
Alex Denner increased its stake in Achillion Pharmaceuticals Inc (ACHN) by 17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sarissa Capital Management Lp bought 363,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 28.04% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Alex Denner held 2.50M shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.20M, up from 2.14M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sarissa Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Achillion Pharmaceuticals Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $493.87M market cap company. The stock increased 0.85% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $3.57. About 299,032 shares traded. Achillion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ACHN) has declined 2.57% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.12% the S&P500.
